visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with several close-up shots of a finished golden-brown pancake cut into wedges, arranged around a small white bowl filled with bright red chili sauce. The pancake shows visible pieces of green broccoli, orange carrots, and red tomatoes embedded in the egg and chicken base. (2) A person wearing clear plastic gloves uses a sharp chef's knife to slice a raw pink chicken breast into thin strips and then into small cubes on a light-colored wooden cutting board under bright studio lighting. (3) The chicken cubes are transferred to a clear glass bowl where hands add black pepper and salt from small containers. An egg white is poured in, and the mixture is stirred by hand to marinate. (4) Chopped green broccoli florets, diced red tomatoes, orange carrot bits, white onion pieces, and shredded cabbage are added to the bowl. The chef then pours whisked yellow eggs over the entire mixture and stirs it thoroughly with chopsticks. (5) In a medium-full shot, the chef pours oil into a black non-stick pan on a stovetop and uses chopsticks to spread the chicken and vegetable mixture evenly. A glass lid with a blue rim is placed on top to steam the ingredients. (6) After 5 minutes, the chef is shown in an upper-body shot attempting a dramatic flip of the large pancake. It lands slightly off-center but mostly intact, releasing steam. (7) The final shots return to a close-up of the sliced wedges, highlighting the thick cross-section of colorful vegetables and white chicken meat, finishing with a graphic call-to-action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo acoustic guitar BGM kicks in with a bright percussive beat. A male narrator introduces the 'Chicken and Seasonal Vegetable Pancake' with high enthusiasm and clear articulation. (2) Rhythmic percussive thud sounds occur as a knife hits a wooden board, syncopated with the BGM. (3) A subtle liquid splash sound accompanies the addition of egg white. The narrator's pitch rises as he lists salt and pepper. (4) High-frequency rustling of gloves and glass bowl clinking creates a busy acoustic texture as ingredients are mixed. (5) A distinct metallic click of a burner igniting is followed by a crisp sizzling sound as the batter hits the hot pan. (6) A hollow thud occurs as a glass lid is placed down. (7) Narrator counts 'One, two, three' with increasing arousal, followed by a loud synthesized 'Whoosh' and a messy thud as the pancake is flipped. (8) A sharp 'Ding' bell sound effect signals the dish is complete, followed by the narrator's positive concluding remarks over a swelling guitar outro.
